aeon.what_changed_at_this_pin: Two commits since 479b6637: 47a3316f (CLIP-ANCHORS-MISSING-FILE) adds the top-level `"anchor_overlay": true` (tools/clip_anchors.py refuses an overlay whose anchors.toml is missing or undeclared); 67f7787d (S2CLIP-REGION-MUSIC step 6) adds a per-clip `music` key, `"SONG_S2_EHZ"` on ehz_act1 and `"SONG_S2_CPZ"` on cpz_act1 (a SONG_* NAME from games/sonic4/config/sound_ids.emp, never a number; clip_manifest.py R3 refuses anything else and refuses two clips of one zone naming different music). No rectangle, corridor or grid moved; the file still has no final newline. Aurora's reader, src/core/formats/donors/clip-manifest-doc.ts, keeps the RAW object: both keys survive parse -> append -> serialise, and the round-trip row compares every pre-existing clip object whole, so a writer that dropped `music` goes red (measured at row 221 by mutation). Aurora does not model `music`: nothing in Aurora reads a song id.
